help.title: Where do I find this data?
help.step1: Open the Mailgun SMTP configuration screen in a new tab.
help.step2: Copy the SMTP server (host) shown there and paste it into the "SMTP Server" field.
help.step3: Copy the port (usually 587) into the "Port" field.
help.step4: Use the email of your Mailgun account as "Username".
help.step5: Create or use the SMTP password shown by Mailgun and paste it into "Password".
help.step6: Fill in the "From email" (where emails are sent from) and the "From name".

help.title: Where do I find this data?
help.step1: Get your Key/API token on the Voice Monkey tokens page.
help.step2: Copy it and paste it into the "API token" field.
help.step3: Choose the speaker where you want alerts announced on the speakers page.
help.step4: Copy the corresponding Device and paste it into the "Device" field.
